title: Shankar Sharma at BFSI Summit: Budget 2023 shouldn't tinker with LTCG tax
text:
BS BFSI Summit LIVE

: The fireside chat with market maven Shankar Sharma is underway on the second day of the Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit. Shankar, in conversation with BS' editorial director, AK Bhattacharya, is sharing his views on the road ahead for the markets amid global volatility.

WATCH LIVE

CLOSING BELL

Stock market highlights

: Equities languished in red on Thursday as fears of a global slowdown amid Covid-19 fears in China and likely recession in the US and Europe weighed. The S&P BSE Sensex dropped 241 points, or 0.4 per cent, to end at 60,826 levels in a broad-based sell-off. The Nifty50 gave up the 18,150-mark to close at 18,127, down 72 points or 0.4 per cent.

The indices hit their respective lows of 60,637.24 and 18,068.60 during the day.

The Nifty PSU Bank and Realty indices fell over 1 per cent, while the Nifty Auto, Private Bank, and Media indices declined 0.8 per cent each. Individually, UPL, Bajaj Finserv, IndusInd Bank, L&T, Tata Steel, BPCL, M&M, Tata Motors, Dr Reddy's Labs, and Axis Bank slumped up to 2.45 per cent.

Meanwhile, in the broader market, the BSE MidCap index dipped 0.77 per cent, and the SmallCap counterpart slipped 1.8 per cent.
